pages.title: Eternal Spark
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplies to: §r Swords, axes, tridents$(br2)§lEffect: §r Attacks build up to 3 Spark stacks and deal void damage based on max health; spreads to nearby hostile mobs on death.$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Crafting recipe (next page)$(br)Conflicts with Entropy and Levi's Echo
